title: Existence of one normalized integral reduction presentation
statement: Fix l, E, Y, D, hl and a TensorPresentation a as in lem-sf-integral-hom-models-exist. For each fixed n there is a ReductionPresentation from a at level n.

proof.text: Ordinary scalar extension and restriction have unit x maps to 1 tensor x. Balanced tensor associativity gives the comparison and its inverse by multiplication of coefficient factors. Apply the left-derived universal property to the same source tensor presentation; its counit square is the required normalization.
